name: Kurosu Taichi
source:
Taichi calls himself "The Love Aristocrat". He is trying to act as a normal human, while hiding his score of 84% on the adaptation exam, which is almost beyond human boundaries. Also, he's a pervert.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
